statusHelp.ON_HOLD: Paused — waiting for a decision or other work (needs a reason)
statusHelp.CLOSED: Finished work, checked and closed by a person
statusHelp.CANCELLED: Decided not to do it, or a duplicate (needs a reason)

ON_HOLD.title: Put on hold
ON_HOLD.body: Pause the work. It stays an open issue and its due date still counts. Write what it is waiting for.
ON_HOLD.placeholder: e.g. Waiting for a design decision · continues after #12

CANCELLED.title: Cancel this issue
CANCELLED.body: Decide not to do it (duplicates too). It becomes a closed issue: Closed on is filled with today when empty, and Completed on is cleared. Write why it will not be done.
CANCELLED.placeholder: e.g. Duplicate of #12 · no longer needed

statusReason.label: Reason
statusReason.help: Kept as a comment in the history.

help.RELATES: The issues are related. There is no direction.
help.BLOCKS: The target issue can start only after this one is done.
help.PRECEDES: The target issue comes after this one.
help.DUPLICATES: This issue is the same work as the target issue.

list.emptyBody: Issues you create appear here. Track them by type, status, assignee and dates.
list.emptyBodyReader: This project has no issues yet.
list.jumpToHelp: Numbers are unique in the workspace — opens that issue directly.
list.emptyBodyWorkspace: Issues of the projects you can read gather here. Create issues from a project page.

create.title: New issue
create.description: Choose a type and a title to create an issue. If you leave the manager empty, you become the manager.

form.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Password reset email never arrives
form.managerHelp: Leave empty to become the manager yourself.
form.managerLocked: Changing the manager needs the 'Assign issue managers' permission.
form.peopleUnavailable: You cannot see the workspace member list, so only the current value can be chosen.
form.parentHelp: Leave empty for a top-level issue.
form.statusDatesHelp: Moving to Done fills Completed on with today, and moving to Closed or Cancelled fills Closed on, when they are empty. Cancelling clears Completed on. Moving back to Registered, In progress, Testing or On hold clears both.
form.statusCreateNote: On hold and Cancelled are set after the issue is created, together with a reason.
form.startAfterPlanned: The start date is after the planned end.
form.startAfterDue: The start date is after the due date.
form.completedAfterClosed: Completed on is after Closed on.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Write what needs to be done, why, and when it is finished. You can use ## headings, lists, tables and code blocks.
form.estimateHelp: The planned working time. Time actually spent is logged separately under Time log on the issue page.
form.estimateInvalid: Enter a number of hours from 0 to 10000, e.g. 8 or 2.5.
form.agentSessionHelp: Name of the AI session working on this — optional
form.modulesHelp: Modules this work changes — pick several, or none
form.modulesEmpty: This project has no modules yet — add them on the project's Modules screen.
form.projectHelp: You can move the issue to another project — only projects where you can create issues are listed.
form.projectMoving: Saving moves it to {{name}}. The number stays the same.
form.parentMoving: Moving clears the parent link while the parent stays in the current project. Set it again after the move.
form.modulesMoving: Only modules with the same key in {{name}} are kept; the rest are dropped. Pick them again after the move.
form.projectNoTarget: No other project to move to — issues move only to projects where you can create issues.

edit.heading: Edit issue
edit.notesHelp: If you write it, it is kept as a comment with this change in the history.
edit.notesRequiredHelp: Moving to On hold or Cancelled needs a reason. It is kept as a comment with this change in the history.
edit.notesRequired: Write why you are moving it to On hold or Cancelled.
edit.statusReasonNote: Moving to On hold or Cancelled needs a reason in "Reason for the change" below.
edit.conflictBody: Someone changed this issue after you opened it. Reload to see the current content, then edit again. Reloading discards your changes here.

view.notFoundBody: The number is wrong or the issue was deleted.
view.archivedBanner: This issue belongs to an archived project. It cannot be changed until the project is restored.
view.conflict: Someone else changed it first. The current content has been reloaded.
view.diagramInvalid: The diagram syntax is not valid.
view.diagramStale: The current text cannot be drawn, so the last drawn diagram is shown.

link.targetHelp: Search by number or title — any issue you can read in this workspace, also in other projects.

journal.revisionHelp: This change created revision {{no}}. Open it to see the diff.
journal.viaSystemHelp: Changed by the server itself, not by a person (for example renumbering issues per workspace).

comment.label: Comment (Markdown)
comment.placeholder: Write a comment. Markdown is supported.
comment.removeBody: This deletes the comment. It stays in place as "Deleted comment" and cannot be restored. Files uploaded with it stay in the Attachments tab.
comment.conflict: This comment was edited elsewhere first. The latest text is loaded and your edit is kept.

remove.title: Delete issue
remove.body: Issue to delete: #{{number}} {{title}}. Once deleted, this issue and its links can no longer be seen. This cannot be undone.
remove.hasChildren: This issue has child issues ({{count}}), so it cannot be deleted. Move or delete the child issues first.
remove.confirmLabel: To confirm, type the issue number {{number}}

workLog.title: Time log
workLog.help: Anyone who can edit this issue can log their own time, not only the assignee. Log as often as you work on it.
workLog.notePlaceholder: e.g. Tracked down the sign-in error
workLog.removeBody: Delete the entry {{name}} · {{date}} · {{hours}} h. It is removed from the total, and the history records who deleted it.
workLog.dateFuture: You cannot log time for a future date. Choose today or an earlier date.
workLog.hoursInvalid: Enter hours greater than 0 and at most 24, e.g. 1.5.
workLog.noteTooLong: The note can be at most 1000 characters.

revisions.emptyBody: Every change to the issue fields adds a revision. Compare revisions here.
revisions.diffSummary: Revision {{from}} → revision {{to}} · fields changed: {{fields}} · description lines added: {{added}} · removed: {{removed}}
revisions.diffFirst: Revision {{to}} created the issue · fields set: {{fields}} · description lines: {{added}}
revisions.diffFromNothing: Empty issue → revision {{to}} · fields: {{fields}} · description lines: {{added}}
revisions.reversed: You are comparing in reverse: revision {{from}} is newer than revision {{to}}.
revisions.coarse: Too much changed to match line by line. It is shown as all old lines removed and all new lines added.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.empty: This issue has no attachments yet.
attachments.emptyHelp: No attachments yet. Uploaded files collect here, and images can be placed inside the description or comments.
attachments.dropHelp: You can choose several files at once; they upload one by one.
attachments.insertHelp: Images appear at the cursor; other files go in as download links. You can also paste or drag and drop.
attachments.afterCreate: Images and files can be added after the issue is created — on the edit page, in comments, or on the Attachments tab.
attachments.copyTooltip: Copy Markdown to paste into the text
attachments.copied: Markdown copied. Paste it into the description or a comment.
attachments.copyFailed: Could not copy. The browser blocked the clipboard.
attachments.removeBody: Delete {{name}} ({{size}}). Markdown that points to it stays in the description and comments but will no longer open. The history records who deleted it.
attachments.imageMissing: Image unavailable — deleted, or not an attachment of this issue

editor.outlineEmpty: Headings (#) appear here as an outline.
editor.heading: Heading · paragraph
editor.linkTextHelp: Used when no text is selected. Leave empty to show the URL.
editor.linkInvalid: This URL can't be opened. Use an http, https or mailto URL, or a path in this app (/…).

templates.workspaceDescription: Per-type outlines that fill a new issue's description. Every project uses these unless it overrides them.
templates.projectDescription: Per-type outlines that fill new issue descriptions in this project. Types not overridden here inherit the workspace default.
templates.noSections: No sections — each heading (#) becomes a section.
templates.help: Each heading (#) is a section. End it with (optional) if it may stay empty. Missing required sections are flagged before saving an issue (not blocked).
templates.tooLong: Templates can be up to {{max}} characters.
templates.empty: A template can't be empty. To use the level above, reset it instead.
templates.readOnly: You can view this template but not edit it.
templates.conflict: Someone else changed it first. The latest version is loaded — your edits are kept.
templates.resetWorkspaceTitle: Reset the {{type}} template to the built-in one?
templates.resetProjectTitle: Reset the {{type}} template to the workspace default?
templates.resetWorkspaceBody: The workspace template is removed and the built-in one is used. Projects that don't override it change too. You can edit it again afterwards.
templates.resetProjectBody: This project's override is removed and the workspace default is inherited. You can edit it again afterwards.
templates.missing: Required template sections are missing: {{sections}}. You can still save.

move.title: Move to another project?
move.children: Subtasks: {{count}} (with their own subtasks) move along.
move.parent: Parent #{{number}} stays in {{from}}, so the parent link is cleared (recorded in the history).
move.modules: Related modules are kept only if {{to}} has an active module with the same key; the rest are dropped (recorded in the history).
move.kept: The number (#{{number}}), comments, attachments, work logs, links and history stay as they are.
move.permission: You need edit permission in {{from}} and create permission in {{to}}.

workspaceList.title: Issues
workspaceList.description: Issues of every project you can read in this workspace. Numbers are unique in the workspace; the project is an attribute of the issue.
